blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it

findings.evidence: Err(error) => return Err(format!("rates feed {url}: {error} after {ATTEMPTS} attempts")),
findings.recommendation: Emit a `warn!`/`error!` with fields (attempts, error) on the final failure, or confirm the caller logs it, so that stale rates kept by the caller do not go unnoticed for days.
findings.title: Final fetch failure is returned but never logged or counted

findings.recommendation: Return a typed error (e.g. an enum wrapping `reqwest::Error`, or `anyhow::Error` with context) so the caller can distinguish a missing variable, a transport failure and an invalid body, and keep the source chain.
findings.title: Errors flattened to String, losing their source chain

findings.recommendation: Retry only on transport errors, timeouts, 429 and 5xx; fail at once on other 4xx (e.g. a wrong `RATES_FEED_URL` returning 404) so the misconfiguration surfaces without the backoff delay.
findings.title: Permanent HTTP errors (4xx) are retried like transient ones

findings.evidence: let rates: Rates = response.json().map_err(|e| format!("rates feed {url}: invalid body: {e}"))?;
findings.recommendation: Keep the URL out of error strings (or log only its host), in case `RATES_FEED_URL` ever carries an API key in its query string; line 37 does the same.
findings.title: Feed URL embedded in error messages
